A LITTLE LOVE GOES A LONG WAY

Keep your pieces
beautiful.

Simple rituals for your favourite jewellery.

Make it the finishing touch

Put jewellery on after perfume, lotions, and cosmetics. Remove it before swimming, exercising, or showering.

Give every piece its own space

Store pieces separately in a soft pouch or lined box to help prevent tangling and scratches. Keep them in a dry place.

A gentle clean, a lasting glow

Gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth after wearing. Care varies by material and gemstone; follow the specific instructions supplied with each piece.
